The path result: '并在容纳已判定时，把所容纳的（步，形成）对可列入一个有限列表的两条水平路径之间的每一个扩展排在上面（只证明了这一方向；…）', then '在第七章 §4.9 的活动、支撑与世系假设之下，一条无尽持存的世系实际所走的进程，从不能列入这样的列表（第七章 §4.9），所以在那里这一论证路线无话可说' (the glossary's words; Flow.persists_not_listsAdmitted, PersistingChoices.lean:853). items.item: (3) COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md:30, 'A generative direction': H19 and the anchor's ethics (H2, H12, H14, H15, H16 a)
items.how: '…ranks higher, so ranking by widening adds no premise…' → 'On a finite listing widening is exactly what every additive weighting counting each listed item above zero ranks higher, and ranking by widening adds no premise beside the life's own concern: where the condition holds, that concern already does it.' Added after the condition's sentence the fronts' short form: 'on the reading of significance as what lies within a center's reach, it holds where relations close, read across all steps, and read in time, only from some step on, where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation (07 §4.11)'. Self-concern defined as the anchor does ('Call a life's order over courses self-concerned when it ranks above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach'), and the ranking kept on the across-all-steps reading ('Where the condition holds de se, read across all steps, that order already ranks…'), since the ranking theorems take Unrestricted (selfAscribed (ownClosure rel) center), not the from-some-step-on form (the ch08 agent's point). The path result with decided admission and admitted pairs, without 'one way'; 'the course of a line that persists without end never fits such a list (07 §4.9), so there this route is silent'. C: '(`Comparison`, with every claim counted as living; in general, above every course it extends by a claim counted as living)'.

17: 'as an order holding one's own continuation (self-concern, …)' → 'as a self-concerned order (one ranking above what it widens every widening that adds to its own continuation, read as what lies within its reach; a hypothesis whose forming is not shown)' (H14). 77: the path result (H15); 'Elsewhere a result names the order it takes, in most of them any order meeting the requirement C' → 'Elsewhere each ranking result names the requirement on an order it takes: C (`Comparison`) in many, J1 and J2 in the direction's, self-concern alone in some (§1)', counted in the Lean (below); 'Seeing them is needed there for a choice to answer to their loss, and not enough' (H13). 101: 'seeing is needed for a selection to answer to a loss, and not enough' (H13, 07's 'does not show' words). items.item: (6) connection_map.py:942, the map page's note, and its pin
items.how: Now: 'A ranking result takes what it ranks under as hypotheses, listed apart: the continuation condition, and the requirement on an order it takes, in many of them C (`Comparison`), in the direction's J1 and J2, in others self-concern; where the condition holds de se, a self-concerned order ranks every extension between two level paths whose admitted pairs fit in a finite list, with admission decided, so that their admissions end. Each represents a scope or a property of an order within the account, used as a hypothesis where a theorem takes it, and none stands on the edge.' ('Each represents…' was already there from the seventh pass; 'neither' → 'none', three hypotheses.) 'In most of them C', as the brief proposed, was not borne out by a count of the Lean: by a grep of theorem signatures, Comparison or ComparisonUnder is a hypothesis of 43 theorems (about 15 of them concluding a ranking), Priority (J1/J2) of 14 (the direction's and the frontier's), IncreasingInOwn of 44 (most of them characterizations, about 8 rankings), so 'many' is said. test_connection_map pins the new wording and asserts 'the order it ranks by' and 'finite list, one way' absent.
